canonical_example.translation: These pearls are made of plastic; they're not real.

canonical_example.translation: The accident was a real tragedy. More than 20 people died.

canonical_example.text: Sé que tu sonrisa no era auténtica porque se te notaba en la mirada.
canonical_example.translation: I know your smile wasn't genuine because you could tell from the look in your eyes.

canonical_example.translation: This guy's great! And he can really play the guitar!

canonical_example.translation: Ivana is going to get married to an Indian she met in New Delhi.

canonical_example.translation: The Indians attacked the British fort from the north.
